judged_text: The if/else block is closed with `<%- end if %>`, which the ERB handler compiles to the Ruby statement `end if` with no modifier condition — invalid Ruby syntax that fails at template compilation. Every render of the embed page raises ActionView::Template::Error (SyntaxError) and returns a 500, so after the 30-second reload triggered by loading.html.erb the iframe permanently shows an error instead of comments; the controller specs do not catch it because rspec controller specs do not render views.
